name: Osteopetrosis-hypogammaglobulinemia syndrome
aliases: Autosomal recessive osteopetrosis with immune deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and laboratory diagnostic criteria for osteopetrosis-hypogammaglobulinemia syndrome

criteria.description: Diffuse increased bone density and sclerosis on radiographic imaging
Marked reduction in serum immunoglobulin levels (IgG, IgA, IgM)
History of recurrent severe bacterial infections due to immunodeficiency
Evidence of bone marrow failure or pancytopenia
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with osteopetrosis and immune dysfunction

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of diffuse osteosclerosis on imaging, hypogammaglobulinemia, and recurrent bacterial infections
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory

laboratory: Low serum immunoglobulin levels (IgG, IgA, IgM)
Pancytopenia or bone marrow failure features
imaging: Diffuse osteosclerosis and increased bone density on X-ray
other: Recurrent bacterial infections due to hypogammaglobulinemia

distinguishingFeatures: More prominent bone marrow failure without immune deficiency
Profound T and B cell deficiency without osteosclerosis
Early onset severe infections without bone abnormalities

redFlags: Recurrent severe bacterial infections in infancy
Progressive bone marrow failure with pancytopenia
Neurological deficits due to cranial nerve compression
